
  ▲ vercel storage command

  Create, connect, and manage storage resources (Blob, Global Config,           
  Marketplace, and 1P) for your Projects                                        

  Commands:

  list                 List storage resources in the current scope        
  create      name     Create a storage resource (blob, global-config)    
  inspect     store    Show the details of one storage resource           
  delete      store    Delete a storage resource. This cannot be undone   
                       and removes its project connections, so it always  
                       requires interactive confirmation.                 
  connect     store    Connect a storage resource (Blob, Marketplace, or  
                       1P) to a project                                   
  status      [store]  Show storage connections, their environments,      
                       credential mode, and environment variables         
  update      store    Update an existing storage connection              
                       (environments, prefix, or credential mode)         
  disconnect  store    Disconnect a storage resource from a project.      
                       Removes its environment variables, so it always    
                       requires interactive confirmation.                 


  Global Options:

       --cwd <DIR>            Sets the current working directory for a single   
                              run of a command                                  
  -d,  --debug                Debug mode (default: off)                         
  -Q,  --global-config <DIR>  Path to the global `.vercel` directory            
  -h,  --help                 Output usage information                          
  -A,  --local-config <FILE>  Path to the local `vercel.json` file              
       --no-color             No color mode (default: off)                      
       --non-interactive      Run without interactive prompts (default: on when 
                              an agent is detected)                             
  -S,  --scope                Set a custom scope                                
  -t,  --token <TOKEN>        Login token                                       
  -v,  --version              Output the version number                         


  Examples:

  - List the stores in the current scope

    $ vercel storage list

  - Create a store and connect it to the linked project

    $ vercel storage create my-uploads --type blob --access private
    $ vercel storage connect my-uploads --yes

  - Inspect what is connected today

    $ vercel storage status
